## Language: ASD-STE100
Write all text (this file, `README.md`, `docs/`, `SECURITY.md`, skills, comments, commit messages, PR text) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English. Do not use complex sentence structures or ambiguous terms. Use short, clear sentences and precise vocabulary. Avoid idioms, metaphors, and figurative language. Be consistent in terminology and style throughout the project.
